profile.headline: Software Engineer & Project Manager @ Fiserv
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
As a full-stack developer with a BS in computer science from NJIT, I have gained valuable skills and experience in web and mobile application development, using various technologies and frameworks such as JavaScript, React, Angular, .NET, C#, Node.js, Docker, SQL Server, Blazor, and AWS. 

My latest work experience was at UPS, where I developed a parser to convert data in logs into a JSON format and turn the JSON data into an API using a Node Server. I also developed a front-end application that captured all mailboxes and application connections in a read-only state, and configured it to send notifications for disconnected mailboxes and high queue sites. Additionally, I have completed multiple certifications, such as AWS Academy Graduate and Android Development, to enhance my knowledge and skills in cloud computing and mobile development. 

I am passionate about learning new technologies and solving complex problems. I am seeking new opportunities to apply my skills and learn from different experiences. I am eager to join a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained React Native mobile applications, leveraging the power of the framework to deliver an enhanced user experience
• Designed and implemented scalable and efficient backend systems using Node.js, ensuring seamless integration with front-end applications
• Designed and optimized relational databases(PostgreSQL) for efficient data management on GCP
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams, contributing to the successful delivery of high-quality software products within project timelines
• Conducted testing and debugging to enhance application performance and reliability

A SaaS API application to send a delayed/schedule message back through a HTTP callback. EchoMQ's purpose is to eliminate constraint of not going outside contained service and reduce application architecture. EchoMQ is a pay-as-you-go model, where you get charged for the services that you use and no extra charges.

Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Twilio SendGrid, Stripe, GCP, Docker, MongoDB, CloudFlare

projects.title: SimuStocks
projects.description:
SimuStocks (Simulated Stocks) is a website for people that want to get into stocks and would like the practice. The website emulates this experience by initially giving the user a certain amount of virtual money and lets you play around with that money and buy stocks; there is no harm, go crazy.

Tech Stack: Angular, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize(ORM), Netlify, Render
